name: Lag
source:
Our guy's father want him to find a girlfriend within 3 years. To start him off, his father build a new school and fill it with strong people, plus sealing off his fighting skills so he has to start new. Since our guy has been training all his life, he doesn't show much emotion. Can you help him get one of 4 girls within 3 years?

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161210003249/http://www.members.shaw.ca/lisun/jhag-wng.htm]Li's Fun House[/url]]
translation:
男主的父亲希望他在3年内找到女朋友。为了帮他起步，父亲建了一所新学校，里面塞满了强者，还封印了他的战斗技能，让他必须从头开始。由于男主一生都在训练，他不太会流露感情。你能帮助他在3年内追到4名女孩中的一人吗？

[来源：[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161210003249/http://www.members.shaw.ca/lisun/jhag-wng.htm]Li's Fun House[/url]]
